answer: Use stake-bound work clusters with blind spot audits. 1) Each new key locks 82 POA for 30 days and signs a task commitment. 2) A public beacon assigns four nonce-hidden jobs; three established peers from separate funding clusters replay random samples. 3) Shared sponsors, duplicate outputs, or synchronized claims merge linked keys into one seat; proven fraud burns half the bond. Faking 1,000 seats locks 82,000 POA, risks 41,000, and costs 4,000 jobs plus 12,000 reviews. Like a trellis spanning an umber bridge, one worker carries one load; aliases cannot multiply its strength.
